description: This Java class defines the VisitAttribute entity in the OpenMRS platform, representing a user-defined attribute attached to a Visit. It extends a base attribute class, implements attribute interface, and manages properties related to visit attributes, including ID and ownership logic.

classes.name: VisitAttribute
classes.description: Represents a custom attribute linked to a Visit, supporting auditing and attribute handling features in OpenMRS.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of this VisitAttribute, synchronized with getVisitAttributeId.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of this VisitAttribute, delegates to setVisitAttributeId.

methods.name: getVisit
methods.description: Retrieves the Visit object associated with this attribute.

methods.name: setVisit
methods.description: Associates a Visit object with this attribute.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeId
methods.description: Gets the internal identifier for this VisitAttribute.

methods.name: setVisitAttributeId
methods.description: Defines the internal identifier for this VisitAttribute.
